name: botofthespecter-desktop
description: BotOfTheSpecter Desktop — OBS WebSocket connector and bot control
author: YourStreamingTools

scripts.dist: npm run fetch:mediamtx && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch:mediamtx -- win32-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch:mediamtx -- darwin-x64 darwin-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run fetch:mediamtx -- linux-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run dist
